An important issue that arises for this case that does not arise for Case 1 is switch stress. That is, the large voltage spike on the AC side is sufficient to damage the converter switches. Therefore, the controller along with the linear devices must provide a filter to prevent this from happening. It can be seen in Fig. 20. and Fig. 21. that the switch stresses do not exceed the input DC voltage magnitude. Therefore, the switches are protected from the voltage pulse.
